			limit = { var:csm_target = flag:concord situation:the_christian_church = { situation_current_phase = conversion_phase } }
			trigger_event = csm.135
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:csm_target = flag:investiture_crisis situation:the_christian_church = { situation_current_phase = reform_phase } }
			trigger_event = csm.139
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:csm_target = flag:saeculum_obscurum situation:the_christian_church = { situation_current_phase = reform_phase } }
			trigger_event = csm.143
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:csm_target = flag:concord situation:the_christian_church = { situation_current_phase = reform_phase } }
			trigger_event = csm.148
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:csm_target = flag:reform_phase situation:the_christian_church = { situation_current_phase = crusade_phase } }
			trigger_event = csm.152
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:csm_target = flag:fragile_unity situation:the_christian_church = { situation_current_phase = crusade_phase } }
			trigger_event = csm.154
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:csm_target = flag:concord situation:the_christian_church = { situation_current_phase = crusade_phase } }
			trigger_event = csm.157
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:csm_target = flag:reform_phase situation:the_christian_church = { situation_current_phase = concord } }
			trigger_event = csm.161
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:csm_target = flag:fragile_unity situation:the_christian_church = { situation_current_phase = concord } }
			trigger_event = csm.163
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:csm_target = flag:conversion_phase situation:the_christian_church = { situation_current_phase = concord } }
			trigger_event = csm.166
		}
		else_if = {

			trigger_event = csm.168
		}

		remove_variable = csm_target
